key_catalyst: TSMC's raised capex to $60-64B triggering a semiconductor-wide selloff while 10-year yield surged to 4.60% near cycle highs on 208K jobless claims
reasoning: Today's -1.07% QQQ decline was materially masked by Apple's +4% surge to an all-time high on a one-time regulatory catalyst; without that cushion, the semiconductor complex destruction (TSMC sell-the-news on record earnings, memory chips down 8-9%) and 10-year yield ripping to 4.60% near the cycle high would have produced a much larger drawdown. The 7/13 precedent shows this exact combination—geopolitical escalation, rising yields, and semi sector collapse—produced a -1.90% session, and the yield environment today is even worse than that day. With Apple's catalyst exhausted, the underlying weakness in QQQ's tech-heavy composition is exposed heading into tomorrow.
